LumberOverviewFeaturesInside the appGetting startedQuestions
01 / Overview

Desktop log viewer

A read-only tool for inspecting application logs and troubleshooting errors. Lumber leaves the original files unchanged, builds an index, and reads lines on demand instead of loading the entire file into the interface.

02 / FEATURES

Features

01

Live tail

Follow lines as they arrive. Scrolling up pauses Follow; returning to the bottom resumes it.

02

Search and filters

Combine plain-text or regex search with include/exclude conditions, log levels, and JSON field filters.

03

Split panes and tabs

Compare different sections of one file or multiple files side by side. Organize files into tab groups.

04

Keyboard controls

Search, filter, and navigate with the command palette. Jump between errors and warnings and bookmark important lines.

03 / INTERFACE

Inside the app

Select an image to view it at a larger size.

01 / 03

Investigate while logs keep arriving

Follow tracks new lines automatically. Scroll up to pause and inspect a particular event. A new-lines indicator lets you know what has arrived while you were looking elsewhere.

02 / 03

One command palette for everyday actions

Search, filter, highlight, and navigate to a line or timestamp from one entry point. Select text in a log before opening the palette to prefill it.

03 / 03

Adjust the view to your work

Choose a light or dark theme and switch between English and Korean. Use word wrap, highlight rules, and bookmarks to organize what you need to inspect.

04 / GETTING STARTED

Getting started

01

Download the app

Choose the installer for your operating system and CPU from GitHub Releases.

02

Open a local log

Open a plain-text or JSON Lines file. The original file remains unchanged.

03

Search, filter, compare

Apply the conditions you need and inspect files using tabs and split panes.

Installation and platforms

Releases include macOS installers for Apple Silicon and Intel, and a Windows installer. The repository contains installation instructions and current requirements.

05 / FAQ

Questions

Built with
Tauri 2RustReactTypeScript
Is it free?＋

Yes. Lumber is a free app published under the MIT license. Source code and releases are available on GitHub.

Does it modify my logs?＋

No. Lumber is a read-only viewer. Search and filter operations change the view, not the file.

Can I connect remote log sources?＋

Lumber currently works with local files. SSH, Docker, and network streams are not currently supported.

What should I know before installing?＋

Current builds are not code-signed. See the repository README and Releases for platform-specific installation instructions and the latest status.
